brief.body: CAMPAIGN BRIEF SERENITY — A Story in Layers Invite Lavish audiences to explore SERENITY through a refined creative story of light, floral feeling and soft musk language, without a performance claim. Demo / Mock data PRODUCT FOCUS SERENITY SKU 6290360533636 / 100014 AUDIENCE & MARKETS UAE · GCC Illustrative premium-fragrance audience in the UAE/GCC interested in the emotional and visual character of a signature scent; not a measured segment. CREATIVE ANGLE A single SERENITY bottle anchors a sequence of visual impressions: a luminous introduction, floral softness, warm quiet textures and a clear Lavish signature. “Layers” refers to the creative narrative of one perfume, not physical perfume mixing or a verified note sequence. Warm, cinematic, understated, graceful and fact-conscious; spare typography and generous negative space. CHANNELS & LANGUAGES Instagram Reels (concept) · TikTok (concept) EN / AR KEY MESSAGE One SERENITY fragrance; more than one way to experience its character through creative storytelling.
